# Session History Search
A sidebar panel that searches the text of **every past Session** and jumps back to the conversation
a hit came from. Built for the "I know I asked for this somewhere, but in which chat?" case.

## What you get
- A magnifier icon in the left sidebar rail (`sidebar.panellist`, order 8) labelled **历史搜索 / History

**.
- A panel (`main` key `session-history-search`) with a search box, a "只看我发的消息 / Only my messages

" toggle, a manual "重建索引 / Rebuild index" action, and result cards.
- Each card shows the Session ti
tle, its workspace folder, how long ago the newest hit was, how many messages matched, and up to fou

r highlighted snippets labelled 我 / 助手.
- Clicking any result opens that Session in the conversation

lighted snippets labelled 我 / 助手.
- Clicking any result opens that Session in the conversation view.
## How it searches
`POST /plugin/session-history-search/search`
[代码示例省略，未执行]
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`GET /plugin/session-history-search/health` reports whether the Session Query service is mounted and
how many Sessions are cached.
### Why not the FTS index
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-query-sqlite` indexes with `tokenize = 'unicode61'`. A run of CJK ideograp
hs between punctuation becomes **one token**, so 插件 does not match 创建一个可以搜索插件的工具 — Chinese content i
s effectively unsearchable through that index (this is also why the workspace sidebar's built-in con
tent search misses Chinese).
This plugin therefore uses `sessionQuery.listSessions()` + `filterEvents(id, [{ kind: 'text', text:
query }])`. The `kind: 'text'` predicate is the first-party literal, case-insensitive scan over each
event's semantic text — it is applied per Session, which keeps Chinese, English, mixed text and par
tial words all searchable with no word segmentation to get wrong.
Consequences worth knowing:
- Cost is proportional to history size (each scanned Session is decompressed and parsed), so the sca

n has a 10 s wall-clock budget and reports `stats.partial` when it runs out.
- Sessions are ordered

newest-first, so a partial scan still surfaces the most recent matches.
- Results are cached per `(s
ession, query, userOnly)` for 5 minutes (capacity 400), and settled Sessions only. Repeating a searc
h therefore finishes the sessions the previous run could not reach, within the same budget — coverag

e grows without ever rescanning what was already done. Live Sessions are always re-read.
- Sessions
without a workspace (`header.cwd === undefined`) are skipped, matching what the sidebar shows.
`openSession` cannot address a message inside a Session, so a result opens the Session at its end; t
he highlighted snippet is what tells you where to look.
## Files
| File | Role |
| `index.js` | Host half: the two routes, the per-Session text scan, the cache. Injects `webServer`,

`sessionQuery`, `connection`. |
| `client.js` | Browser half: locale dictionaries, sidebar icon, pa

nel view. No CSS file, no Client package imports, theme tokens only. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle

patch that inserts the plugin. |
| `locale/zh.json`, `locale/en.json` | Marketplace display metadat

a. |
| `icon.svg` | Package icon. |
## Notes
- Both halves tolerate a missing `sessionQuery`: the panel renders a normal error with a retry actio

n instead of crashing the slot.
- The route answers 405 for non-POST, 413 above 64 KiB, 400 for an e

mpty query or bad JSON, 503 when the Session Query service is not mounted.
- Requests the `connectio
n` service marks untrusted are refused before any work happens.
